name: ServingScaleCard
job: A recipe or kit card with a servings stepper where every ingredient quantity rolls to the new amount in real time, so the card does the arithmetic for the visitor
visitor_action: tap plus or minus; when the servings number is focused, arrow keys step servings (Page Up/Down by 5, Home/End to the limits)
mobile: full-width card, photo on top, wide 56px stepper buttons spread across the card
motion: amounts roll vertically digit by digit with a staggered spring, changed amounts get a brief tomato highlight, stepper presses with spring (reduced-motion: numbers swap instantly)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: photo/copy mismatch, worst-case column alignment, 375 stepper layout)

art_direction: Pantry enamel: cream enamel card, cobalt rim stripe, flat tomato-red stepper, speckle texture (gloss dropped per contemporary-polish rule)
